scripts.//build: vite build only fills _app/dist. Nothing is published until `publish` syncs it out to the repo root, which is where GitHub Pages serves from.
scripts.//publish: Copies dist/ to the five repo-root paths this project owns and then ASSERTS the whole URL contract. It refuses to touch terms/, privacy/, iptv, profile/, data/ or device/agent/ — those are published directly by the browser console and must never depend on a build.
scripts.//serve:site: Serves the REPO ROOT, which is exactly what GitHub Pages serves: the published build output plus the static contract it must not touch. `npm run preview` only serves _app/dist, so it cannot show /terms/{slug}/ or /profile/ at all.
scripts.//check:live: Byte-compares every path that must never change against the deployed site. Needs no server. This is the pre-push gate for the app-store URLs.
scripts.//: Composite scripts below are the single source of truth for .vscode/tasks.json. Task definitions stay thin wrappers so the two cannot drift.
scripts.//verify: typecheck is separate from build on purpose: `vite build` does NOT type-check, so a green build proves nothing about types.
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.deploy: npm run verify && npm run publish
